articles.title: 17,000 URLs Reveal How ClickFix Turns Trusted Websites Into Malware Traps: Report by CTM360
articles.summary:
ClickFix has become the most common way attackers get into enterprise networks, and it does it without an exploit, an attachment, or a file on disk. Our new global threat report traces the technique from a novelty in late 2023 to a subscription product with on-chain infrastructure and a state-sponsored user base, and explains why blocking malicious domains is no longer a useful defense.

articles.title: TeamFiltration Campaign Compromises Seven Microsoft 365 Accounts Using Default Passwords
articles.summary:
Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of an active TeamFiltration campaign codenamed UNK_CondorFiltration that has targeted over 5,700 accounts across 28 Microsoft 365 tenants.
